question.text: The compound that would produce a nauseating smell/odour with a hot mixture of chloroform and ethanolic potassium hydroxide is

solution.text:
When primary amine react with chloroform and ethanolic potassium hydroxide, they produce - isocyamides as main product. The reaction is also known as carbyl amine reaction. $\mathrm{Ph}-\mathrm{NH}_{2} \frac{\mathrm{CHCl}_{3}}{\mathrm{KOH} \text { (ethanolic) }} \mathrm{Ph} \cdot \mathrm{N} \longrightarrow \mathrm{C}$
(Nauseating smell)
